Для оценки укажите рост и вес, а лучше е: For an estimate, enter your height and weight, and ideally your waist and neck measurements.
По росту, талии и шее (метод ВМС США) с: Based on height, waist and neck (US Navy method), adjusted with other formulas. Error is about ±3–4 %.
По росту и талии. Добавьте замер шеи — о: Based on height and waist. Add a neck measurement to make it more accurate.
Грубая оценка по росту и весу: она не от: A rough estimate from height and weight: it cannot tell muscle from fat. Add waist and neck measurements.
Наведите на линию на схеме, чтобы увидет: Hover a line on the diagram to see how to take the measurement correctly.
Записей пока нет. Добавьте первую на вкл: No entries yet. Add the first one on the “Entry” tab.
Если включён раздельный ввод — меряйте п: If separate entry is on, measure the right and left sides separately.
Лента — на середине шеи, чуть ниже кадык: Place the tape around the middle of the neck, just below the Adam's apple. Snug, but not digging in. Head straight, eyes forward, shoulders relaxed.
Обхват по самым широким точкам дельтовид: Measure around the widest points of the deltoids, with the tape level across the chest and shoulder blades. Stand straight with your arms relaxed at your sides.
Лента проходит на уровне сосков и под по: The tape runs at nipple level, under the armpits and across the shoulder blades. Arms down, measure after a relaxed exhale; the tape is level and not digging in.
Измеряется на уровне пупка, на спокойном: Measure at navel level after a relaxed exhale: don't suck in or push out your stomach. Keep the tape level. This measurement, together with neck and height, is used to estimate body fat.
По самой выступающей части ягодиц, лента: Around the most prominent part of the glutes, tape level. Stand straight, feet together, muscles relaxed.
Середина плеча между плечевым суставом и: The middle of the upper arm between shoulder and elbow, arm relaxed and hanging. Tape perpendicular to the arm. Pick one way (relaxed or flexed) and stick to it.
В самой толстой части, примерно на треть: At the thickest part, about a third of the forearm's length below the elbow. Arm relaxed, palm facing forward.
В самой толстой части, примерно на 5–10: At the thickest part, about 5–10 cm below the gluteal fold. Weight on both legs, muscles relaxed, tape level.
В самой широкой части икры. Стойте прямо: At the widest part of the calf. Stand straight with your weight on both legs, muscles relaxed.
Отключённый замер не показывается, но уж: A disabled measurement is hidden, but values you already entered are kept.
All measurements are disabled in settings.
Данных пока нет. Добавьте запись на вкла: No data yet. Add an entry on the “Entry” tab.
Линия — сглаженный тренд, точки — отдель: The line is a smoothed trend and the dots are individual entries, so daily fluctuations don't distort the picture.
Давление вносится парой: верхнее и нижне: Blood pressure is entered as a pair: systolic and diastolic
Верхнее давление должно быть больше нижн: Systolic pressure must be higher than diastolic
Отключённый показатель не показывается,: A disabled parameter is hidden, but entries you already made are kept.
Все медицинские показатели отключены в н: All medical parameters are disabled in settings.
Данные носят справочный характер и не за: The data is for reference only and does not replace a doctor's advice.
Нет включённых показателей. Включите их: No parameters are enabled. Turn them on in settings.
Руки: бицепс, предплечье, длина рукава,: Arms: biceps, forearm, sleeve length, wrist, palm. Legs: thigh, calf, ankle, foot length and width. When off, a single combined value is entered.
По длине стопы показывается примерный ра: An approximate shoe size is shown from the foot length.
Примерный размер обуви: EU {eu} · US {us: Approximate shoe size: EU {eu} · US {us} · UK {uk}. Sizes differ between brands.
От одной плечевой точки (где плечо перех: From one shoulder point (where the shoulder meets the arm) to the other across the back. The tape lies across the upper shoulder blades. Used for jackets and shirts.
От выступающего позвонка у основания шеи: From the prominent vertebra at the base of the neck down the spine to the waistline. Used for jackets and blazers.
От плечевой точки (края плеча) вдоль сле: From the shoulder point (edge of the shoulder) along the slightly bent arm over the elbow to the wrist bone.
Вокруг запястья над косточкой, плотно, н: Around the wrist just above the bone, snug but not digging in. Used for watches and bracelets.
Вокруг ладони по самой широкой части, бе: Around the palm at its widest part, excluding the thumb. Used for gloves.
От паха вдоль внутренней стороны ноги до: From the crotch along the inside of the leg to the floor or to the desired trouser length. Easiest to measure on trousers that already fit well.
От линии талии вдоль боковой стороны ног: From the waistline along the outside of the leg to the floor or to the desired trouser length.
Лента проходит по лбу над бровями и ушам: The tape runs across the forehead above the eyebrows and ears and around the most prominent part of the back of the head. Used for hats and helmets.
Над щиколоткой, по самой тонкой части. Н: Just above the ankle at the thinnest part. Used for socks, high boots and braces.
Встаньте на лист бумаги, отметьте самую: Stand on a sheet of paper, mark the tip of the longest toe and the heel, and measure the distance. Better in the evening; if your feet differ, use the larger one. An approximate shoe size is shown from the foot length.
Расстояние между самыми широкими точками: The distance between the widest points of the foot (at the base of the toes). Helps you choose a narrow or wide shoe last.
Утром, если сегодня вес ещё не внесён: In the morning, if today's weight is not entered yet
Пора взвеситься: сегодня вес ещё не внес: Time to weigh in: today's weight is not entered yet
